items.source:
Repository bean definitions are considered lazy, lazily injected and initialized only on first use, i.e., the
application might have fully started without the repositories initialized.
items.translation: 仓库 Bean 定义被视为懒加载，仅在首次使用时进行注入和初始化；也就是说，应用程序可能已经完全启动，但仓库尚未初始化。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source: Enumeration to define in which way repositories are bootstrapped.
items.translation: 用于定义仓库引导方式的枚举。

items.source: Repository proxies are instantiated eagerly, just like any other Spring bean, except explicitly marked as lazy.
items.translation: 仓库代理会像其他任何 Spring  Bean 一样被急切实例化，除非显式标记为懒加载。

items.source:
Repository bean definitions are considered lazy and clients will get repository proxies injected that will
initialize on first access.
items.translation: 仓库 Bean 定义被视为懒加载，客户端将获得注入的仓库代理，这些代理将在首次访问时进行初始化。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Repository proxies are instantiated eagerly, just like any other Spring bean, except explicitly marked as lazy.
Thus, injection into repository clients will trigger initialization.
items.translation: 仓库代理会像其他任何 Spring  Bean 一样被急切实例化，除非显式标记为懒加载。因此，向仓库客户端注入将触发初始化。

items.source:
Repository bean definitions are considered lazy and clients will get repository proxies injected that will
initialize on first access. Repository initialization is triggered on application context bootstrap completion.
items.translation: 仓库 Bean 定义被视为懒加载，客户端将获得注入的仓库代理，这些代理将在首次访问时进行初始化。仓库的初始化会在应用程序上下文引导完成时触发。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if this enum class has no constant with the specified name
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果此枚举类没有指定名称的常量，则抛出该异常。

items.translation: NullPointerException - 如果参数为 null
